column1: # Incidents: part lost, low power, signal lost and back, crew lost (plan v4 features 6, 7, 8, 10). New keys: in_
# Columns and values: audio/lonapse/README.md. UTF-8, tab separated, # starts a comment line.
# Explosion words are allowed only in part_lost rows. signal_lost has no MC rows: Control cannot hear the crew.

column15: english
Is that thing drifting away ours?

column14: Parece que sí. No pasa nada, seguid.
column15: Looks like it. No problem, carry on.

column14: Algo pequeño se ha soltado. Nada grave.
column15: Something small came loose. Nothing serious.

column14: Recibido. Lo vemos en los datos.
column15: Copy. We see it in the data.

column14: Se ha caído una pieza. Creo que no la necesitábamos.
column15: A part fell off. I don't think we needed it.
Let's hope not. Noted.

column14: Algo explotó ahí fuera, pero era pequeño.
column15: Something blew up out there, but it was small.
Copy. All good inside?
All good inside.
Something blew up! We lost a part!
Boom! What broke?

column14: Eso no era un ruido normal. Falta una pieza.
column15: That wasn't a normal noise. A part is missing.
Something broke off the hull!
Control, something blew up outside.
Copy. Check your systems.

column14: Hemos perdido una pieza. Seguimos de una pieza... casi.
column15: We lost a part. We're still in one piece... mostly.
Copy. Give us a report.
Minor damage. Still flying.
Explosion outside! We're still here.
We see you. Keep control.
That hit tore something off.
Copy. How much damage?
Hard to say. We're still in one piece.
Everything's exploding! It's falling apart!
Boom, boom, boom! Make it stop!
We're losing parts! Lots of parts!
Another one blew up! Control, help!
There's barely any ship left! Do something!
Explosions everywhere! Hold on tight!
Copy, we saw that. Keep us posted.

column14: Control aquí. Hemos perdido los datos de una pieza.
column15: Control here. We lost the data from a part.
Breathe. Tell us what still works.

column14: Vimos la explosión. Calma ahí arriba.
column15: We saw the explosion. Stay calm up there.

column14: Recibido. Comprobad la presión de la cabina.
column15: Copy. Check the cabin pressure.

column14: Entendido. Olvidad la pieza y pilotad la nave.
column15: Understood. Forget the part and fly the ship.

column14: La batería está casi vacía. Apago lo que sobra.
column15: The battery is almost empty. Shutting off what we don't need.
Copy. Good idea.

column14: Desplegad los paneles solares, si los tenemos.
column15: Deploy the solar panels, if we have any.
Copy. We're watching the charge.

column14: Queda poca carga. Apago todo menos la radio.
column15: Charge is low. Shutting down everything but the radio.
Good thinking. We need to hear you.

column14: Las luces se apagan poco a poco.
column15: The lights are slowly dimming.
It's the battery. Save power.

column14: La pantalla parpadea. Eso no es buena señal.
column15: The screen is flickering. That's not a good sign.

column14: Carga baja. Apagad lo que no uséis.
column15: Low charge. Shut down what you're not using.
Who left the lights on?

column14: Batería baja. Esto ya no es broma.
column15: Battery low. This is no joke now.
The lights are back!
Copy. Charge is rising.
The battery is recovering.

column14: Bien. Ya podéis encender la cafetera.
column15: Good. You can turn the coffee maker back on.
Power is stable again.
Perfect. We see it here too.
Control? Is anyone there?
We've lost the signal.

column14: La radio no contesta. Nadie nos oye.
column15: The radio is silent. Nobody can hear us.

column14: Sin conexión con Control. Seguimos por nuestra cuenta.
column15: No link with Control. We're on our own.

column14: Solo hay ruido en la radio.
column15: There's only static on the radio.

column14: Control, si nos oís, todo va bien... creo.
column15: Control, if you can hear us, all is well... I think.

column14: Ya no hay señal. Qué silencio.
column15: No signal anymore. So quiet.
We'll have to decide without help.
Control? ...Control?
No answer. We'll have to wait.
Can anyone else hear Control?
No. Nothing at all.
The signal is gone.
Then we're in charge now.
Control? Can you hear us now?
Yes. We have you again.
The signal is back!

column14: Recibido. Os oímos alto y claro.
column15: Copy. We hear you loud and clear.
Control, did you miss us?
A little. Well, a lot.
We have a link again.
Finally. What did we miss?
Nothing. Well, almost nothing.
Ship here. Are you still there?
Always. We never left.
The radio works again.
Copy. Telemetry is back.

column14: Control a la nave. Hemos perdido a un miembro de la tripulación.
column15: Control to ship. We have lost a crew member.

column14: Lo sentimos mucho. Siempre formará parte de esta misión.
column15: We are very sorry. They will always be part of this mission.

column14: Un momento de silencio en la radio, por favor.
column15: A moment of radio silence, please.

column14: Hoy hemos perdido a alguien. Seguid con cuidado.
column15: We lost someone today. Carry on carefully.

column14: Confirmado. No hay respuesta. Lo sentimos.
column15: Confirmed. There is no response. We are sorry.

column14: Mantened la calma. Traed al resto a casa.
column15: Stay calm. Bring the others home.

column14: Hemos perdido a alguien. No hay palabras.
column15: We lost someone. There are no words.

column14: Control, se ha ido. No pudimos hacer nada.
column15: Control, they're gone. There was nothing we could do.

column14: Seguiremos adelante. Por quien no vuelve.
column15: We'll carry on. For the one who won't come back.
